title: Hardcoded AWS Access Key ID Detected
explanation: Recognizable AWS Access Key ID committed directly to source repository.
recommendation: Immediately revoke and rotate the exposed credential. Move sensitive values to secure environment variables (.env) or a secret manager.

verification.summary: Unit tests pass with patched environment variable fallback.

title: Potential SQL Injection via Dynamic Parameter Interpolation
explanation: Raw SQL query constructed via dynamic string concatenation with user-controlled input.
evidence: const query = "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE owner_id = " + req.params.ownerId;
recommendation: Refactor query construction to use parameterized queries, prepared statements, or an Object-Relational Mapper (ORM).
